steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: This bastard hasn't done anything at all. All he does is stand there and watch...

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: Because there's no need. Your chief is very outstanding.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: ...Very outstanding.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Have all the enemies been eliminated?

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: The commander is not back yet, meaning the battle is probably not finished yet. The smarter gangsters will certainly avoid her, go separate ways, and find a chance to attack us on their own.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: A real guerilla will waste too much of our time...
He looks at you, eyes full of calculation and scheming.

options: That's your trouble. Not my business.
Do you need our help to fight?

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: ...You're right.
He looks at you, considers briefly, and gives a faint smile.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: No, I'm sure you'll seize the chance to escape. If that happens, I'll have to detonate the bomb.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: Just kidding.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: Our partnership doesn't require you to fight. The Legion has got enough men. As long as the Chief is alive and refrains from escaping, that's enough.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: How about this, if you want to stay safe, you can stay here. Hide yourselves well and take some rest.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: I'm bringing some guys to help the commander clean up the trouble. Then I'll come back to pick you up.
He gives orders to his subordinates, then turns to add before setting off.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: You're smart. Don't get yourself into trouble.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: There are still too many gangsters hiding around here. Not all of them are brainless junkies like the Gonzales. Don't go wandering around. No one will come to save you if anything happens.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: See you around. Remember, don't die.
Of course.
Once you've made sure he's out of sight, you borrow Hella's pipe and draw a huge arrow on the sandy ground pointing toward the dark alley. Then, you slip into it on your own.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, what is this for...?
As expected, several men in black suits soon come out from behind the container, each of them carrying an oriental-styled long sword.
Good evening, sir. <color=#fb9259>Yagyu</color> here.
